name: @attakk/mocks
comment: Dev-only: the shop and admin register these MSW handlers so they can be built without the API running, and the API replays the fixtures through its real routes as a contract test. Never built to dist and never a production dependency — consumers resolve it through the `source` export condition, exactly like @attakk/types, and pull it in as a devDependency so `pnpm deploy --prod` prunes it and msw from every image.
